conf.description: cisco-asa device-admin dataset, snmp-trap format (CISCO-SYSLOG-MIB clogMessageGenerated trap): no stock Elastic integration or Cribl pack ingests SNMP traps, so this is a genuine Cribl-side parsing pipeline (mechanism: cribl-pipeline) rather than a thin passthrough. An upstream SNMP trap receiver terminates the PDU and forwards the decoded varbinds as JSON; this pipeline extracts them, maps the MIB fields to ECS, and re-derives log.syslog.severity.code from the MIB's 1-8 enum.

conf.comment: cisco-asa / device-admin / snmp-trap: CISCO-SYSLOG-MIB clogHistTable varbinds for the 605/611/111/502 management-plane family, forwarded as JSON by an upstream SNMP trap receiver since neither Cribl nor the Elastic integration decodes SNMP PDUs. clogHistMsgText carries the full 254-byte-truncated ASA sentence -- including 111010 executed-command text -- still keyed by the same per-message-ID grammar as the syslog-raw feed. This pipeline does not re-run that body grok and only maps the MIB-level fields; it also does NOT apply the map's 111009/111010 secret-redaction recommendation here, since that recommendation targets the parsed command field and the map gives no equivalent instruction for the trap transport specifically -- flagged as a gap in the README.

functions.description: document the varbind source and scope of this pipeline
extract the JSON-encoded varbind object the upstream SNMP trap receiver forwards
map the mapped/near-1:1 CISCO-SYSLOG-MIB fields onto their ECS targets per the field table
apply the field table's explicit severity-offset transform and route the two unmapped varbinds to their custom cisco.asa.snmp.* targets
tag the event with its dataset
